_doc: Polymaker PolyLite PETG, printed, for analysis: a second maker's figures beside petg (Bambu Lab PETG HF), so a design can be checked against either or see the spread between makers. Stiffness and strength along the layers (x-y) and across them (z); low and high are the sheet's own spread either side.
name: petg-polylite

modulus.source: Polymaker PolyLite PETG technical data sheet V5.4 (ISO 527, GB/T 1040; specimens printed at 240 °C, 100% infill), https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0548/7299/7945/files/PolyLite_PETG_TDS_EN_V5.4.pdf

modulus_z.source: Polymaker PolyLite PETG technical data sheet V5.4 (ISO 527, GB/T 1040)

strength.source: Polymaker PolyLite PETG technical data sheet V5.4 (ISO 527, GB/T 1040)

strength_z.source: Polymaker PolyLite PETG technical data sheet V5.4 (ISO 527, GB/T 1040)

poisson.rule: Poisson's ratio (Polymaker publish none): taken as the kit's petg, an estimate
poisson.source: Typical for PETG, as the kit's petg

density.source: Polymaker PolyLite PETG technical data sheet V5.4 (ISO 1183, GB/T 1033)

softening.rule: Heat deflection temperature, ISO 75 at 0.45 MPa: where a part under a little load starts to creep
softening.source: Polymaker PolyLite PETG technical data sheet V5.4 (ISO 75)
